items.title: Scaling Properties of Text Conditioning in Visual Generation
items.description: We study empirical scaling properties for text conditioning in visual generation. Such properties have rarely been measured because diffusion loss does not scale with the number of tokens in natural-language prompts. Surprisingly, we find that the converged diffusion loss scales with the amount of structured language in the prompt. items.cn_summary: 研究视觉生成中文本条件的缩放特性，发现扩散损失与提示词量关系。
